title: Xanthe and the Archive
author: Freya Nystrom
blurb: Ulyana Voss, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
